title: Usage gets a closer look
summary:
Daily usage graphs and exports arrived alongside smoother app authorization, a simpler Pollen checkout, and tidier public pages.

Enter gained a Usage tab with daily graphs for API requests and Pollen spending. You can switch time ranges, filter by API key and model, inspect per-model details, and distinguish tier usage from paid Pollen. A new daily usage endpoint returns JSON or CSV, and detailed exports can include up to 50,000 records.

BYOD authorization now accepts redirect hostnames up to 253 characters as temporary API key names, rather than rejecting names over 32 characters.

The checkout change removes the crypto purchase option and routes Pollen pack purchases through Polar. Existing crypto balances are preserved.

highlights.title: Explore your API usage
highlights.text: See daily requests or Pollen usage in Enter, filter by API key and model, and switch between seven-day, 30-day, and all-history views. Download the details as CSV.

highlights.title: Daily usage by API
highlights.text: Query `/api/account/usage/daily` for usage grouped by date, model, and billing source, returned as JSON or CSV. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
